assumptions: Standard ideal lumped-circuit capacitor and voltage-source models apply.
Stored charge means the magnitude of charge on either plate.

notes: The equation and independence argument agree with pass 1. All four variants give 4.5 × 10⁻⁴ C; changing the disconnected capacitor's charge has no effect under the standard circuit model. Units satisfy F·V = C. The certified display 0.0004 C is coarse but compatible with rounding to one significant figure using ties-to-even; 0.00045 C would preserve the two significant figures of the inputs. This display rounding does not warrant invalidation under the admission standard.
